bugs.fix:
.sticky-item { position: sticky; top: 0; }
/* Parent must NOT have overflow: hidden/scroll/auto for sticky to work */
bugs.explanation: `position: sticky` does not work when any ancestor has `overflow: hidden`, `overflow: scroll`, or `overflow: auto`. The sticky element becomes sticky within the nearest scrollable ancestor. If the parent clips overflow, there's no scroll to stick within.
